facts.process_name: Form a limited liability company in Virginia
facts.trigger: Someone wants to form a limited liability company

trigger_source.quote: One or more persons may act as organizers of a limited liability company

source.quote: An organizer need not be a member of the limited liability company after formation has occurred.
The Commission shall admit any such certificate to record in its office.

steps.action: Sign and deliver articles of organization

source.quote: signing and delivering articles of organization to the Commission for filing
For filing any one of the following, the fee shall be $100
If the Commission finds that the articles of organization comply with the requirements of law and that all required fees have been paid, it shall issue a certificate of organization.
the Commission shall by order issue the certificate if it finds that the document complies with the provisions of this chapter and that all required fees have been paid
The Commission shall admit any such certificate to record in its office.

decisions.question: Do the articles of organization comply?

source.quote: A name for the limited liability company that satisfies the requirements of § 13.1-1012
the name of its initial registered agent at that office
The post office address, including the street and number, if any, of the principal office of the limited liability company
all required fees have been paid
it shall issue a certificate of organization

outcomes.description: The LLC exists from the time the certificate issues

source.quote: The existence of a limited liability company or a protected series shall begin at the time the Commission issues a certificate of organization

gaps: State formation is only half of starting a business: most Virginia localities also require a local business licence (BPOL) under their own ordinances, authorised by Va. Code § 58.1-3700 et seq. That local step is scored separately.
A delayed effective date for the certificate (subsection D of § 13.1-1004) is not modelled.
